calls.reason: The only independent record is an October 2019 LeCun tweet that acknowledges one narrow critique about quantities. Nothing in the packet confirms the data-hunger, interpretability, hallucination or inadequacy points.

LeCun's March 2024 Fridman interview backs his side. Marcus's side rests on a thin DLD summary, nothing tests the 'unlike many other people' contrast, and the AAAI tutorial shows others stressing world models too.

The evidence is mixed. ACCORD shows commonsense reasoning breaking down as tasks get harder, while Gurnee and Tegmark find learned space and time representations. None of the studies isolates what ordinary LLM training provides on its own.

The Nature paper shows AlphaGeometry pairing a neural language model with symbolic deduction to solve 25 of 30 olympiad problems, against 10 for the prior state of the art. NS-CL, built with outside institutions, adds another neurosymbolic result.
